prediction: Generate exact integer model predictions once for all eligible rows, persist immutable score cache; every threshold reuses scores
primary: Weighted mean actual signed direction benefit of selected refresh versus all-defer counterfactual; no invented per-refresh CPU cost
outcomes: Counterfactual movement/planning event counts and per-query rates separately; no conversion to direction-cost penalties
dev_shortlist_rule: Best development mean net direction benefit (ties highest threshold). Second: highest threshold with >=90% of positive best benefit; if same as best or no positive best, next-best net benefit threshold distinct from best. Include128 as reference. Never-discretionary retained baseline. Freeze shortlist before opening heldout metrics.
selection_limit: Gen003 fit uses these DEV maps, so shortlist is optimistic/in-sample. No existing matching gen003 OOF predictions; no new fits authorized in this sweep.

uncertainty.method: paired whole-map multinomial cluster bootstrap; fixed evaluation hierarchy weights, same map multiplicities for all thresholds; 2000 draws
uncertainty.threshold_scope: DEV-shortlisted thresholds and128 versus never and128; report95% percentile intervals, no reselection inside bootstrap
